verses.en: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ by the commandment of God our Saviour, and Lord Jesus Christ, which is our hope;
verses.pt: Paulo, apóstolo de Jesus Cristo segundo o mandado de Deus, nosso Salvador, e do Senhor Jesus Cristo, nossa esperança.
verses.en_web: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ according to the commandment of God our Savior and the Lord Jesus Christ our hope;
verses.en_bbe: Paul, an Apostle of Jesus Christ, by the order of God our Saviour and Christ Jesus our hope;

verses.en: Unto Timothy, my own son in the faith: Grace, mercy, and peace, from God our Father and Jesus Christ our Lord.
verses.pt: Para Timóteo, meu verdadeiro filho na fé. Graça, misericórdia e paz da parte de Deus, nosso Pai, e de Cristo Jesus, nosso Senhor.
verses.en_web: to Timothy, my true child in faith: Grace, mercy, and peace, from God our Father and Christ Jesus our Lord.
verses.en_bbe: To Timothy, my true child in the faith: Grace, mercy, peace, from God the Father and Christ Jesus our Lord.

verses.en: As I besought thee to abide still at Ephesus, when I went into Macedonia, that thou mightest charge some that they teach no other doctrine,
verses.pt: Assim como te roguei quando eu estava indo à Macedônia, fica em Éfeso, para advertires a alguns que não ensinem outra doutrina,
verses.en_web: As I urged you when I was going into Macedonia, stay at Ephesus that you might command certain men not to teach a different doctrine,
verses.en_bbe: It was my desire, when I went on into Macedonia, that you might make a stop at Ephesus, to give orders to certain men not to put forward a different teaching,

verses.en: Neither give heed to fables and endless genealogies, which minister questions, rather than godly edifying which is in faith: so do.
verses.pt: Nem prestem atenção a mitos nem a genealogias intermináveis, que mais produzem discussões que a edificação da parte de Deus na fé.
verses.en_web: and not to pay attention to myths and endless genealogies, which cause disputes, rather than God’s stewardship, which is in faith—
verses.en_bbe: Or to give attention to stories and long lists of generations, from which come questionings and doubts, in place of God's ordered way of life which is in faith;

verses.en: Now the end of the commandment is charity out of a pure heart, and of a good conscience, and of faith unfeigned:
verses.pt: O fim do mandamento é o amor que vem de um coração puro, e de uma boa consciência, e de uma fé não fingida.
verses.en_web: but the goal of this command is love, out of a pure heart and a good conscience and sincere faith;
verses.en_bbe: But the effect of the order is love coming from a clean heart, and a knowledge of what is right, and true faith:

verses.en: From which some having swerved have turned aside unto vain jangling;
verses.pt: Alguns se desviaram dessas coisas, e se entregaram a discursos inúteis;
verses.en_web: from which things some, having missed the mark, have turned away to vain talking;
verses.en_bbe: From which some have been turned away, giving themselves to foolish talking;

verses.en: Desiring to be teachers of the law; understanding neither what they say, nor whereof they affirm.
verses.pt: querendo ser mestres da Lei, mas não entendendo, nem o que dizem, nem o que afirmam.
verses.en_web: desiring to be teachers of the law, though they understand neither what they say, nor about what they strongly affirm.
verses.en_bbe: Desiring to be teachers of the law, though they have no knowledge of what they say or of the statements which they make so certainly.

verses.en: But we know that the law is good, if a man use it lawfully;
verses.pt: Nós, porém, sabemos que a Lei é boa, se alguém usa dela legitimamente;
verses.en_web: But we know that the law is good, if a person uses it lawfully,
verses.en_bbe: We are conscious that the law is good, if a man makes a right use of it,

verses.en: Knowing this, that the law is not made for a righteous man, but for the lawless and disobedient, for the ungodly and for sinners, for unholy and profane, for murderers of fathers and murderers of mothers, for manslayers,
verses.pt: pois sabemos isto: que a Lei não foi feita para o justo, mas sim, para os injustos e insubordinados, para os ímpios e pecadores, para os irreligiosos e profanos, para os matadores dos pais e das mães, para os homicidas,
verses.en_web: as knowing this, that law is not made for a righteous person, but for the lawless and insubordinate, for the ungodly and sinners, for the unholy and profane, for murderers of fathers and murderers of mothers, for manslayers,
verses.en_bbe: With the knowledge that the law is made, not for the upright man, but for those who have no respect for law and order, for evil men and sinners, for the unholy and those who have no religion, for those who put their fathers or mothers to death, for takers of life,

verses.en: For whoremongers, for them that defile themselves with mankind, for menstealers, for liars, for perjured persons, and if there be any other thing that is contrary to sound doctrine;
verses.pt: para os que cometem pecados sexuais, para os homens que efetuam sexualidade com homens, para os que roubam a liberdade das pessoas, para os mentirosos, para os que juram falsamente, e qualquer outra coisa contrária à sã doutrina,
verses.en_web: for the sexually immoral, for homosexuals, for slave-traders, for liars, for perjurers, and for any other thing contrary to the sound doctrine;
verses.en_bbe: For those who go after loose women, for those with unnatural desires, for those who take men prisoners, who make false statements and false oaths, and those who do any other things against the right teaching,

verses.en: According to the glorious gospel of the blessed God, which was committed to my trust.
verses.pt: conforme o evangelho da glória do Deus bendito, que foi confiado a mim.
verses.en_web: according to the Good News of the glory of the blessed God, which was committed to my trust.
verses.en_bbe: Which may be seen in the good news of the glory of the great God, which was given into my care.

verses.en: And I thank Christ Jesus our Lord, who hath enabled me, for that he counted me faithful, putting me into the ministry;
verses.pt: E agradeço àquele que tem me fortalecido, Cristo Jesus, nosso Senhor, porque me considerou fiel, pondo-me no serviço.
verses.en_web: And I thank him who enabled me, Christ Jesus our Lord, because he counted me faithful, appointing me to service;
verses.en_bbe: I give praise to him who gave me power, Christ Jesus our Lord, because he took me to be true, making me his servant,

verses.en: Who was before a blasphemer, and a persecutor, and injurious: but I obtained mercy, because I did it ignorantly in unbelief.
verses.pt: Antes eu era um blasfemo, perseguidor, e opressor; porém recebi misericórdia, pois foi por ignorância que eu agia com incredulidade.
verses.en_web: although I was before a blasphemer, a persecutor, and insolent. However, I obtained mercy, because I did it ignorantly in unbelief.
verses.en_bbe: Though I had said violent words against God, and done cruel acts, causing great trouble: but I was given mercy, because I did it without knowledge, not having faith;

verses.en: And the grace of our Lord was exceeding abundant with faith and love which is in Christ Jesus.
verses.pt: Mas a graça do nosso Senhor Jesus Cristo foi mais abundante, com a fé e amor que há em Cristo Jesus.
verses.en_web: The grace of our Lord abounded exceedingly with faith and love which is in Christ Jesus.
verses.en_bbe: And the grace of our Lord was very great, with faith and love which is in Christ Jesus.

verses.en: This is a faithful saying, and worthy of all acceptation, that Christ Jesus came into the world to save sinners; of whom I am chief.
verses.pt: Esta é uma palavra fiel e digna de toda aceitação: que Cristo Jesus veio ao mundo para salvar os pecadores, dos quais eu sou o principal.
verses.en_web: The saying is faithful and worthy of all acceptance, that Christ Jesus came into the world to save sinners; of whom I am chief.
verses.en_bbe: It is a true saying, in which all may put their faith, that Christ Jesus came into the world to give salvation to sinners, of whom I am the chief:

verses.en: Howbeit for this cause I obtained mercy, that in me first Jesus Christ might shew forth all longsuffering, for a pattern to them which should hereafter believe on him to life everlasting.
verses.pt: Mas por isso me foi concedida misericórdia, para que em mim, o principal, Jesus Cristo mostrasse toda a sua paciência como exemplo aos que haviam de crer nele para a vida eterna.
verses.en_web: However, for this cause I obtained mercy, that in me first, Jesus Christ might display all his patience, for an example of those who were going to believe in him for eternal life.
verses.en_bbe: But for this reason I was given mercy, so that in me, the chief of sinners, Jesus Christ might make clear all his mercy, as an example to those who in the future would have faith in him to eternal life.

verses.en: Now unto the King eternal, immortal, invisible, the only wise God, be honour and glory for ever and ever. Amen.
verses.pt: Ao Rei dos tempos, imortal, invisível, o único Deus sábio, seja a honra, e a glória, para todo o sempre, amém!
verses.en_web: Now to the King eternal, immortal, invisible, to God who alone is wise, be honor and glory forever and ever. Amen.
verses.en_bbe: Now to the King eternal, ever-living, unseen, the only God, be honour and glory for ever and ever. So be it.

verses.en: This charge I commit unto thee, son Timothy, according to the prophecies which went before on thee, that thou by them mightest war a good warfare;
verses.pt: Este mandamento, filho Timóteo, te dou: que, conforme as profecias antes feitas acerca de ti, que batalhes por elas a boa batalha;
verses.en_web: This instruction I commit to you, my child Timothy, according to the prophecies which were given to you before, that by them you may wage the good warfare;
verses.en_bbe: This order I give to you, Timothy my son, in harmony with the words of the prophets about you, so that by them you may be strong, fighting the good fight,

verses.en: Holding faith, and a good conscience; which some having put away concerning faith have made shipwreck:
verses.pt: mantendo a fé e a boa consciência, que alguns rejeitaram, e naufragaram na fé.
verses.en_web: holding faith and a good conscience; which some having thrust away made a shipwreck concerning the faith;
verses.en_bbe: Keeping faith, and being conscious of well-doing; for some, by not doing these things, have gone wrong in relation to the faith:

verses.en: Of whom is Hymenaeus and Alexander; whom I have delivered unto Satan, that they may learn not to blaspheme.
verses.pt: Dentre esses foram Himeneu e Alexandre. Eu os entreguei a Satanás, para aprenderem a não blasfemar.
verses.en_web: of whom are Hymenaeus and Alexander; whom I delivered to Satan, that they might be taught not to blaspheme.
verses.en_bbe: Such are Hymenaeus and Alexander, whom I have given up to Satan, so that they may say no more evil words against God.
